posts.name: Kaivax
posts.cooked:
It’s always a good idea to go over your settings in-game when you first get started. Today, we’d like to suggest that players take a close look at these settings in particular.

image898×713 128 KB

If any of them are not defaulted to your preferred language, you can change them and log out and back in to improve your in-game experience.

Thank you!
